Q7 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
A PMID count is not a quality measure. Ten papers citing one original observation
look like ten pieces of evidence here and are one. This design cannot see that, so
every E3 count is an UPPER bound on corroboration.
CollecTRI aggregates twelve resources that themselves overlap, so its resource
count is not twelve independent groups either.
Absence of a PMID is not absence of evidence -- the binding tier is real ChIP data,
it just has no paper attached to the individual edge.
Loop 187's enrichments were measured on the tiers as-is. Nothing here re-runs them
at E3 only, and the null would have to be rebuilt on the E3 subgraph to do that.
